description: The State's general budget (budget général). By default: total executed spending, by mission and programme, revenue by tax and budget voted for next year. Use it for the State budget; get_public_money family etat is a different perimeter (Insee national accounts of all State administrations). Sections: publicFinances (public finances by sub-sector since 1949), execution (monthly execution, spending by type and ministry, State balance sheet, green budget), legislation (the related finance laws).

section.description: Part to return. Without it, the headline figures and the list of sections.
